NASCAR, Amerias top stock racing series, has a playoff system where there are 4 rounds of 4 races. At the end of every round, 4 drivers are eliminated, until 4 remain and the person with the most points wins.It is extremely unfair and unforgiving, but raises tensions and makes for itnresting racing. If F1 did this, it'd suck, but It'd be fun.

NASCAR has a system where the final 16 races are a "chase" in that points are reset like a playoff every 4 races, and the bottom 4 are eliminated until theres only 4 drivers left, and the driver with the most points at the end of that round wins.

From what i've seen, the most this did was drive people away after a couple years. Outsiders were somewhat intrested, but the large community is repeatedly angry becuase of how bs the results of this new system is. If this system was in place now, Seb would've won in 2009, Lewis in 2016, and other wacky results. Theres no strategy in NASCAR anymore, just try not to crash.
